verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Svelte compiles declarative components to explicit DOM updates and community praises its state sharing (stores/context) and readable generated code, which supports predictable data flow, but there is no direct documentation or example contrasting explicit reactivity with implicit two-way binding or showing how state changes are traced. missing for 10: explicit docs on reactivity/state update model, comparison to two-way binding pitfalls, concrete debugging/tracing examples.
